name: Enchanted Nights
source:
It's your first day as a sous chef at Sweet Enchantments and all you're trying to do is stay on the straight and narrow, but a striking new hire catches you off guard. 

[Source: In-App Description]
translation:
这是你在Sweet Enchantments担任副主厨的第一天。你只想安安分分地做好本职工作，一位引人注目的新同事，却让你猝不及防。

[来源为应用内简介]
